  image of the finite surjection C x Sym^(g-1)C -> C x Sym^g C" (:819-821).

  line; the family is the graph of a degree-g map phi : C -> P^1, so supp D = phi^{-1}(U)

  CHEAPER witness and worth keeping — but it is a new result, not agreement.

  claim):

  1. It is not field-uniform. §7.3 writes the divisor "s_0 + s_inf" and computes l(K
